brief: Recover connected thread startup, capacity and signed page-rounded allocation with explicit resource boundaries.
decl: void startup_thread_initialize(StartupThreadRuntime &state, CleanupRegistry &registry, const StartupThreadPlatform &platform, std::uint32_t count);

bookkeeping.scope: Three complete initialization/capacity/page-allocation routines with actual cleanup registry registration; resource APIs and lock-pool acquisition remain explicit boundaries.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Eight state words, 64 registry slots, positive signed page size and returning resource callbacks; 32-bit wrap and signed page rounding preserved. OS handle validity, memory writes of clear bridge, lock-pool body and actual shutdown excluded.
bookkeeping.acceptance: 1024 complete original-instruction cases including 256 four-call persistent sequences compare returns, all state words/registry slots and boundary call order/arguments on MSVC and Zig; native runtime domain checks return failures independently of NDEBUG.
unresolved: True Windows allocation, handle/critical-section lifetime and thread cleanup body; startup subsystem connection.
